mapper.sql: p.id AS personId, p.display_name AS displayName, p.person_type::text AS personType, p.employee_no AS employeeNo, COALESCE(p.status, '0') AS status, COALESCE(p.note, '') AS note, COALESCE(p.phone, '') AS phone, COALESCE(p.gender, '2') AS gender, COALESCE(p.face_image_url, fp.image_url, '') AS faceImageUrl, COALESCE(fc.face_count, 0) AS faceCount, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM persons p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT image_url FROM face_profiles WHERE person_id = p.id ORDER BY quality_score DESC NULLS LAST, id LIMIT 1 ) fp ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(1)::int AS face_count FROM face_profiles WHERE person_id = p.id ) fc ON TRUE WHERE p.person_type IN ('student', 'staff') AND ( EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM face_profiles x WHERE x.person_id = p.id) OR (p.face_image_url IS NOT NULL AND p.face_image_url <> '') )
AND p.display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{displayName}, '%')
AND p.employee_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{employeeNo}, '%')
AND p.person_type::text = #{personType}
AND COALESCE(p.status, '0') = #{status}
ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT
FROM persons p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT image_url FROM face_profiles WHERE person_id = p.id ORDER BY quality_score DESC NULLS LAST, id LIMIT 1 ) fp ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(1)::int AS face_count FROM face_profiles WHERE person_id = p.id ) fc ON TRUE WHERE p.id = #{personId} AND p.person_type IN ('student', 'staff')
SELECT image_url FROM face_profiles WHERE person_id = #{personId} AND image_url IS NOT NULL AND image_url <> '' ORDER BY quality_score DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO persons ( display_name, person_type, employee_no, status, note, phone, gender, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{displayName}, CAST(#{personType} AS person_type), #{employeeNo}, COALESCE(#{status}, '0'), #{note}, #{phone}, COALESCE(#{gender}, '0'), NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM persons ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE persons SET display_name = #{displayName}, person_type = CAST(#{personType} AS person_type), employee_no = #{employeeNo}, status = COALESCE(#{status}, status, '0'), note = #{note}, phone = #{phone}, gender = COALESCE(#{gender}, gender, '0'), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{personId}
UPDATE persons SET face_image_url = #{faceImageUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{personId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM persons WHERE employee_no = #{employeeNo} LIMIT 1
